title: Obelisks: The Way Back
content: The obelisks are the only reliable way home. Each is a tapered tower of rusted plating crowned with a black core that burns cold violet.
Right-click the core and you return to the exact spot you left — the Hollow remembers where each traveler came from, individually.
If you are lost, the resonance scanner points at the nearest obelisk within 128 blocks. They rise about fourteen blocks above the ash; you can see them coming.
Do not mine the core. It will not drop, and the Hollow will notice.
